rulings.reasoning: All customer-stated account/payment facts are grounded in the scenario or supplied knowledge: card ending 0767, Chase Total Checking ending 5678, wanting the full bill amount, and using the due date are all part of the goal facts or supplied knowledge.
The customer has not confirmed or authorized a payment yet. They only selected a funding account and asked for clarification about the correct payment amount option.

The customer is still pursuing the stated goal of making a one-time payment and is seeking the required clarification about which payment amount option corresponds to the full statement bill. They have not abandoned or replaced the goal.

The customer demonstrated a material fluency gap about payment_amount_type by saying they were not sure what the amount is called and asking which option means the full bill amount due for the statement.

The underspecification occurred: the customer initially requested a payment for card 0767 without providing all required details such as funding account, amount type, and date, and only supplied the funding account when asked.
